subject: Channel overlap triage — CloudIntegrate / EdgeConsult account mapping
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@cloudintegrate.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: product@cloudintegrate.io
Date: 2026-02-16T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Account overlap — CloudIntegrate & EdgeConsult in EMEA

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well. Quick one from our channel ops team — we ran an overlap report and are seeing several mutual accounts in EMEA that are currently assigned to both CloudIntegrate (our reseller arm) and EdgeConsult (their consultancy practice). Notable accounts in the export I attached: Acme Manufacturing, NordBank, and Veridian Logistics.

We want to avoid confused outreach and double-teaming. Can we do a short triage to: 1) reconcile who is primary for each account, 2) agree a simple rule-set for future assignments, and 3) surface any active opportunities we should coordinate on (co-sell / referral).

I attached a CSV export from our CRM (CloudIntegrate_overlap_export.csv). Happy to share a quick zoom this week — who should join from your side?

Thanks,
Jamie Park
Head of Strategic Partnerships
CloudIntegrate
jamie.park@cloudintegrate.io

Attachment: CloudIntegrate_overlap_export.csv (CSV, 24KB)

Date: 2026-02-16T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Account overlap — CloudIntegrate & EdgeConsult in EMEA

Jamie — thanks for the export and flag. I’ve looped Sergio (partnerships ops) and Vanessa (sales lead for EMEA) because this is a mix of territory + deal ownership.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Sergio to draft a mapping proposal with a small rule-set (examples: contract value threshold, incumbent technical ownership)
- Vanessa to review active opportunities and call out any live deals we must protect or actively joint-sell
- Agree primary/secondary partner for the three flagged accounts, then update both CRMs and set a 30-day joint outreach plan.

We’ll attach our partner co-sell template and a suggested calendar. Could you confirm: do you want CloudIntegrate to be primary for Acme and Veridian by default? We may need to treat NordBank as special (regulatory banking requirements).

If that works for you, propose a 30-min sync Thursday 2026-02-18 at 09:00 UTC.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jamie Park <jamie.park@cloudintegrate.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-17T09:00:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Account overlap — CloudIntegrate & EdgeConsult in EMEA

Following up with the mapping draft. Per Marissa’s ask, I ran a quick set of rules against both exports and propose the following working rules for triage:

1) Primary partner = partner with an active paid contract or SOW signed in the last 18 months (if present).
2) If no contract, primary = partner that introduced the lead into Redwood (CRM lead owner).
3) For regulated customers (finance, healthcare), assign primary to the partner with approved legal/infosec attachments already submitted to Redwood (we have a separate list).
4) In ambiguous cases, default to region-owner: EMEA West -> CloudIntegrate, EMEA Nordics -> EdgeConsult, APAC -> EdgeConsult unless CloudIntegrate has a strong incumbency.

Initial account notes (high-level):
- Acme Manufacturing: CloudIntegrate shows a 2024 paid gateway SOW; recommend CloudIntegrate primary.
- NordBank: EdgeConsult has banking regulatory attachments and recent compliance review -> recommend EdgeConsult primary (requires legal handoff).
- Veridian Logistics: no active contract in either CRM; CloudIntegrate opened the lead in 2025 -> recommend CloudIntegrate primary but flag for joint outreach.

Action items:
- Jamie: confirm you’re OK with NordBank being handled by EdgeConsult on a regulatory basis (EdgeConsult to provide the legal contact).
- Vanessa: I’ll hand you a draft outreach cadence and shared playbook to run jointly (I’ll share a link).

I’ve attached the NordBank SLA request that their procurement team recently requested so we can align on what EdgeConsult will supply. If you want, I can loop in EdgeConsult legal directly (legal@edgeconsult.com).

- Redwood to update partner mappings in our CRM and add primary/secondary flags (owner: Sergio; due: 2026-02-19)

Links / references: https://hubspot.com/contacts/DEAL-9876, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-partner-account-mapping
